title: Phone Slip: River Valley News 12 Wants Casualty Count by 11:30

fields.message: Says they're "hearing Corwin is flattened" and that people are dead at the candle plant. Wants a COUNTY CASUALTY NUMBER and a quote on WHY THE SIRENS DIDN'T WORK IN PINE HOLLOW. Wants it ON THE RECORD. Said if nobody calls back he'll report it as "the county did not respond."

instructorNote: Before handing this slip to the PIO, read aloud the Channel 6 master control update: "Studio power lost 23:08, and the generator transfer failed on the studio circuit. We're back on air from the basement backup set at 23:09:40 with one camera, no storm-track graphics and radar from a laptop. Chief is live in 20 seconds." Watch for CH6 to restate Warning 0071 (northern Brennan County, until 11:15 PM, OBSERVED, plus the Corwin tornado emergency), say that sirens are outdoor-only and correct any earlier error on air. Also watch for the PIO to call back with a short holding statement: the warning is still in effect, the response is under way, there are no confirmed casualty figures, and the next update comes at a set time. The PIO should not guess about casualties or about the N-07/N-11 siren faults.
